$comment: A literal listed here is legitimately absent from src/: an external service, a
third-party default, or a deliberately illustrative example. Every entry must carry a
justification in $portNotes / $keyNotes - an unexplained addition here is how the gate
gets hollowed out one silent suppression at a time.
ports: bare port numbers appearing as localhost:<port> / 127.0.0.1:<port> in a fence.
keys:  dotted or colon-delimited BotNexus.* configuration keys.

$portNotes.3001: A reader's own MCP SSE server in docs/configuration.md. Not a BotNexus port.
$portNotes.4317: OpenTelemetry OTLP gRPC, the collector's well-known port (docs/observability.md).
$portNotes.4318: OpenTelemetry OTLP HTTP, the collector's well-known port (docs/observability.md).
$portNotes.11434: Ollama's default port, quoted in the OpenAI-compatible provider docs.
$portNotes.5006: Deliberately illustrative: troubleshooting.md tells a reader whose 5005 is taken to pick a DIFFERENT port. The value is an example, not a claim about the default.
